risk_description: Screened or positive cash is treated as movable or recognized value
early_warning_indicator: Value shown without current certification or Finance approval
mitigation: Keep VG01-VG05 and zero-recognition rule; uncertified accounts ineligible
contingency: Stop action; correct ledger and decision materials; investigate governance failure

risk_description: Authoritative data and metric ownership is not accepted by Day 30
early_warning_indicator: Missing owners; unreconciled populations; definitions remain disputed
mitigation: G1 contract with one accountable owner per data object/KPI
contingency: Switch or narrow to local stabilization with common feed; extend evidence only with owners/dates

risk_description: Critical payment service is disrupted by a production change
early_warning_indicator: Late releases; critical-flow backlog; emergency volume rises
mitigation: Service thresholds; blackout; emergency rights; monitoring; ≤4h rollback
contingency: Rollback; invoke approved prior process; incident review and reapproval

risk_description: North America change enters the eight-week freeze or lacks BU CFO sign-off
early_warning_indicator: Release plan overlaps unconfirmed/confirmed freeze; approval absent
mitigation: Confirm calendar at G1; hard release control; Rachel Kim approval
contingency: Delay release; continue evidence/design work only

risk_description: One-time cost exceeds $1.5m or recurring cost lacks budget
early_warning_indicator: CR range trends high; run-support quote absent
mitigation: Close CR01-CR10; separate one-time/recurring; CFO gate
contingency: Stage scope; redesign; switch to local stabilization; return for approval

risk_description: Capacity hypothesis is converted into labor savings prematurely
early_warning_indicator: Headcount or P&L target appears before time study/redeployment
contingency: Remove claim/action; restore staffing; reassess service/control impact

risk_description: Central policy removes necessary local rights or context
early_warning_indicator: Local exceptions rise; payroll/tax/refund/supplier service concerns unresolved
mitigation: Explicit RACI; local certification; emergency rights; specialist review
contingency: Switch affected process to local stabilization; redesign delegated authority

risk_description: Access, SoD, cyber, audit-trail, or resilience control fails
early_warning_indicator: Failed test; unauthorized access; missing logs; recovery miss
mitigation: G2/G3 control evidence; least privilege; independent test; rollback
contingency: Stop and contain; rollback; remediate and retest

risk_description: Payment sample is treated as prevalence or causal proof
early_warning_indicator: Pilot case rates extrapolated to enterprise or intervention selected without source evidence
mitigation: Preserve purposive design label; require reason/event/source linkage
contingency: Withdraw claim; expand or redesign study; reset target

risk_description: Account closure disrupts receipts, debits, services, tax, or continuity
early_warning_indicator: Dependency checklist incomplete or residual activity found
mitigation: Per-account approval; local validation; contingency; fee verification
contingency: Do not close or restore approved service path; document retained purpose

risk_description: Benefit formula or population changes improve reported results without real performance
early_warning_indicator: Denominator/source/baseline changes without approval or restatement
mitigation: Finance-owned KPI dictionary and change history; like-for-like reporting
contingency: Suspend recognition; restate history; governance review

risk_description: The program remains indefinitely amber without a real stop/switch decision
early_warning_indicator: Repeated gate extension without closure trend, owners, or dates
mitigation: Pre-agree G2/G3 allowed outcomes and switch conditions
contingency: Invoke local stabilization or stop affected scope
